subject: Co-sell handshake and marketplace listing kickoff - CloudCo partnership
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@cloudco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Cc: Aisha Kumar <aisha.kumar@cloudco.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Introduction: CloudCo x Redwood - marketplace & co-sell kickoff

Ben,

Following up from the intro last week — CloudCo is running a vertical-first co-sell push across GCP and Azure and we think Redwood would be a great ISV partner. We'd like to align on a quick operational handshake (listing metadata, PKS/SKUs, co-sell certification), confirm tech integration points (API keys / billing hooks), and get a target listing date into our Q3 catalog.

High level asks to start:
- Shared listing metadata template (CSV)
- SKU/pricing mapping and primary billing contact
- Tech validation contact for the marketplace integration and a brief integration test window
- Mutual action plan (MAP) and basic SOW template (legal will run standard MSA)

I can run the marketplace onboarding on our side. Attaching our intake template to speed things up. If useful, we can meet Thursday 10–11 PT for a 30-min handshake.

Attachments: cloudco-intake-template.csv (attachment stub)

Thanks,
Tom Reynolds
Head of Partnerships, CloudCo Partners
TR: +1 415 555 0123
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@cloudco.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Introduction: CloudCo x Redwood - marketplace & co-sell kickoff

Tom — great to meet you (virtually). Thursday 10am PT works for us. Looping in Laura (GTM), Camila (partner ops / marketplace listings), and Sergio (alliances) so we can move fast.

Quick starter materials attached:
- redwood-cosell-checklist.pdf (internal readiness + marketplace tasks)
- redwood-sku-mapping.xlsx (initial SKU mapping template)

Agenda suggestion for Thursday:
1) Confirm listing metadata fields + who owns each column
2) Pricing / SKU mapping approach (consumable units)
3) Who does tech validation and test accounts
4) Timeline + MAP milestones (owner + dates)

Ben Carter
Enterprise Partnerships Lead
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-cosell-checklist.pdf (attachment stub), redwood-sku-mapping.xlsx (attachment stub)
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@cloudco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Cc: Aisha Kumar <aisha.kumar@cloudco.com>, marketplace-ops@cloudco.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Introduction: CloudCo x Redwood - marketplace & co-sell kickoff

Ben / team — thanks for the quick turnaround and attachments.

I pulled the SKU template and filled a first pass of the listing metadata in the intake CSV (attached). Questions from our side:
- For pricing, do you want consumption pricing (per-token equivalent) or a subscription SKU? We typically surface both; need your primary billing contact.
- We also need a tech contact who can validate the marketplace callouts (auth token exchange + billing webhook). Can Camila point to an eng contact or should we use a dedicated partner-integration mailbox?

Confirming Thursday 10am PT for the handshake. I've attached cloudco-listing-metadata.csv with a few notes in the Description column. Also tagging our marketplace-ops team to start a stub listing in our portal.

Attachments: cloudco-listing-metadata.csv (attachment stub)

On Tue, Apr 20, 2027 at 11:03 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference> wrote:
> Tom — great to meet you (virtually). Thursday 10am PT works for us. Looping in Laura (GTM), Camila (partner ops / marketplace listings), and Sergio (alliances) so we can move fast.
> 
> Quick starter materials attached:
> - redwood-cosell-checklist.pdf (internal readiness + marketplace tasks)
> - redwood-sku-mapping.xlsx (initial SKU mapping template)

Best,
Tom
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: CloudCo listing - questions / owners

Team — quick internal sync before the Thursday call. Notes and owners: 
- Pricing model: default to subscription SKU + optional usage add-on. Laura owns pricing decision, Ben will confirm with partner.
- Tech validation: Karthik to own validation of auth flow + billing webhook test. Need an engineer on the call if possible (Karthik, can you be there or nominate someone?).
- Listing metadata: Camila owns the portal metadata and will upload the CSV after our review.
- MAP doc / SOW: Sergio to draft a short MAP and attach a simple SOW template (we'll keep legal out until we have MAP sign-off).

Timing: please review the cloudco-listing-metadata.csv and highlight any fields we should rename or enrich before the call.

Laura Bennett
Director, GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@cloudco.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, marketplace-ops@cloudco.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 17:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Introduction: CloudCo x Redwood - marketplace & co-sell kickoff

Tom — thanks, good meeting today. Recap and next steps below. Attaching a short MAP and draft SOW for your intake.

Recap / owners:
- Listing metadata: Camila will upload the CSV once CloudCo confirms the description columns (target: 2027-05-02)
- Pricing: Laura to propose subscription + usage add-on SKU by 2027-04-28
- Tech validation: Karthik to own test plan. Karthik, we'll need a sandbox token from CloudCo and a test invoice webhook to validate billing events.
- MAP: Sergio to own action items and milestones; I will coordinate with your ops team on the portal stub.

Attachments: draft-sow-co-sell.docx (attachment stub), redwood-cosell-map-v1.pdf (attachment stub)

Ben Carter
Enterprise Partnerships Lead
Redwood Inference

On Wed, Apr 21, 2027 at 08:22 AM Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@cloudco.com> wrote:
> Ben / team — thanks for the quick turnaround and attachments.
> 
> I pulled the SKU template and filled a first pass of the listing metadata in the intake CSV (attached). Questions from our side:

> - We also need a tech contact who can validate the marketplace callouts (auth token exchange + billing webhook). Can Camila point to an eng contact or should we use a dedicated partner-integration mailbox?

Thanks,
Tom
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@cloudco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 16:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Introduction: CloudCo x Redwood - marketplace & co-sell kickoff

Appreciate the recap and the MAP, Ben. Legal on our side will run the MSA against your draft SOW (should be standard). We're going to provision a sandbox token for Karthik and the marketplace-ops team will create a stub listing this week so you can review how fields render in portal.

Tentative target timeline:
- Sandbox & stub listing provisioned: 2027-04-26
- Pricing & SKU finalization: 2027-04-28
- Listing publish target (catalog): 2027-05-10

I'll introduce Aisha (cc'd) who will be our ops lead; she'll run the listing workflow with Camila. Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting this live.

Best,
Tom Reynolds
Head of Partnerships, CloudCo Partners
Attachments: none
